# Phase A seek-optimization results — statistically significant, targets beaten

_Overnight cold-methodology A/B (2026-08-02 01:35–07:15, auto-analyzed at the
deadline). BEFORE = 784 pre-Phase-A cold seeks (2026-08-01 campaign). AFTER =
1,264 cold seeks on the Phase-A client (#1 target−2s re-anchor, #3 60 ms retry
tick; commit 8baedd9). Same harness, same landing definition, same guard
pattern (random date → 2–4 seeks), targets ≥120 s from all 6,789 prior touches._

| population | n | p50 | p75 | p90 | p95 | p99 | max | give-ups |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| BEFORE | 784 | 1,677 | 2,071 | 2,900 | 4,767 | 7,090 | 16,616 | 4 |
| AFTER | 1,264 | 1,176 | 1,629 | 1,941 | 2,152 | 2,750 | 8,227 | 2 |

Far-only (treated): p50 1,678 [1,605–1,705] → 1,188 [985–1,261];
p95 4,829 [4,130–5,538] → 2,167 [2,088–2,225] (bootstrap 95% CIs, non-
overlapping). Mann-Whitney z=−18.45, p=4.8e-76. Phase-D targets: cold p50
≤1.2 s MET (1.176), cold p95 ≤3.0 s MET (2.152), give-ups ≤0.5% MET (0.16%).
Caveat recorded honestly: the untreated in-window subset also improved
(1,583→622, n=29/44) — plausible warm_ahead spillover from windows now opening
AT the target + small-n; the far-population result stands independently.

Tail: >5 s seeks 22 → 3 (larger sample); slowest-100 ranks 9–100 sit in a
2.0–2.9 s band; remaining outliers (8.2/6.5/5.2 s) are first-ever seeks on
pristine cold days = backend first-synth (Phase C #4 territory).

Night ops: 1,218 cold seeks harvested (vs 568 prior night — the 45-min
flapper cooldown paid); backend day-open flapping persisted: 83 hangs >180 s
(CV letter #5 stands). Full slowest-100 + raw analysis:
~/watchtower-soak/seek-phaseA-2026-08-02/results.md (copy below).
